types.description: Harmony XB4 black long-handle selector head, 22 mm, three maintained positions +/-45 degrees; head only

document.title: Schneider Electric — Harmony XB4 metal, Control and signaling units, catalog
document.pages: PDF page 57 (catalog p.55): 'Selector switches with long handle — Heads only', row ZB4BJ3; footnote (1) refers contacts to the body/fixing collar (page 24)

modelingNotes: Operator HEAD only. The catalog lists ZB4BJ3 under 'Heads only' with blank NO/NC contact columns; the contacts appear only in the complete unit XB4BJ33 = (ZB4BZ103 body/fixing collar + 2 NO) + ZB4BJ3 head. Contacts and their screw-clamp terminals belong to the separately ordered body/fixing collar, not to this head.

Manufacturer product page (https://www.se.com/us/en/product/ZB4BJ3/, accessed 2026-09-12) confirms 'Head for selector switch … metal, black, 22mm, long handle, 3 positions, stay put', operator head only with no contact blocks; a choice of contact blocks is ordered separately.

Mechanical scope: Ø22 panel-mount selector actuator, long black handle, three maintained positions I-0-II at ±45° (source '1-0-2 45dgr'), stay put (vs spring-return ZB4BJ5/J7/J8). Standard chromium-plated bezel; optional black metal bezel = suffix 7 (ZB4BJ37).

Zero electrical terminals: no contact, lamp/LED, supply, return, signal, shield, communication or PE/bond terminal is present on the head. No net-joining continuity is asserted; contact/collar membership never manufactures continuity.

Bonding: the metal bezel/collar-to-panel interface is not documented as an electrical terminal, so no PE/bond path is asserted through the head (undocumented mechanical interface, not an installed bond).
No successor or completed suffix substituted.
Position notation I-0-II describes operating positions, not supplied printed legends. Empty circuit functions preserve the mechanical documentation scope. Source order spelling ZB4-BJ3 is retained.

Head-level environmental/standards values (up to IP66/IP67/IP69/IP69K, −40…+70 °C, EN/IEC 60947-5-1, UL 508, CSA C22.2 No 14) are catalog family values and are not modeled as electrical ratings for this zero-terminal head.

connectionCoverage.notes: Mechanical selector head with zero electrical terminals. Switching terminals reside in the separately ordered body/fixing collar + contact blocks (e.g. ZB4BZ10x), which is out of scope for this head. The metal bezel/collar-to-panel bonding interface is not documented as a terminal, so no PE/bond path is asserted.

MOUNT.connector: Ø22 panel-mount selector actuator head; snap-fits to a separately ordered body/fixing collar (e.g. ZB4BZ10x)
MOUNT.description: Mechanical mounting/attachment interface only; no electrical pins.
